description_en: Modifies the attributes of a child instance (VBR) associated with an Express Connect Router (ECR)
description_zh: 修改专线网关（ExpressConnectRouter）关联子实例(VBR)的属性
kebab_example: aliyun expressconnectrouter modify-express-connect-router-child-instance --ecr-id ecr-gny3gqp41n7vrrn5iz --child-instance-id vbr-t4n6xu2d5q0iaad1yl4le --child-instance-type VBR --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyExpressConnectRouterChildInstance

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the Express Connect Router (ECR)
parameters.name: ecr_id

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the VBR
parameters.name: child_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The type of the network instance. Valid values:
VBR: VBR instance
parameters.help_zh:
网络实例的类型。取值：
VBR：边界路由器实例
parameters.name: child_instance_type

parameters.help_en: The description of the child instance. The description must be 0 to 128 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 子实例的描述信息。长度为0～128个字符
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether the request is a dry run only. Valid values:

true: performs a dry run and does not modify service resources.
false (default): sends a normal request
parameters.help_zh:
是否只预检此次请求。取值：

true：发送检查请求，不会修改服务资源。
false（默认值）：发送正常请求
parameters.name: dry_run

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can generate a parameter value from your client to ensure that the parameter value is unique among different requests. The client token only supports ASCII characters.


If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the RequestId of the API request as the client token. The RequestId of each API request is different
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。


若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId不一样
parameters.name: client_token

AccessDeniedDetail.description_en: The details of the access denial

Code.description_en: Indicates whether the call was successful. A return value of 200 indicates success, and other values indicate failure. For the cause of failure, see the error codes
Code.description_zh: 判断调用是否成功。返回值为 200 表示成功，返回其他值表示失败，失败原因参见错误码

DynamicMessage.description_en:
The dynamic error message, which is used to replace `%s` in the ErrMessage error message.

If ErrMessage returns The Value of Input Parameter %s is not valid and DynamicMessage returns DtsJobId, it indicates that the request parameter DtsJobId is invalid
DynamicMessage.description_zh:
动态错误信息，用于替换返回参数ErrMessage错误信息中的`%s`。

如果ErrMessage返回The Value of Input Parameter %s is not valid，且DynamicMessage返回DtsJobId，则代表所传入的请求参数DtsJobId不合法

False: The call failed

True：成功。
